name: milestone-progress
title: Milestone progress
description: A progress bar with named stops along the way, for goals with steps: a funding target, a loyalty ladder, free-shipping tiers.
docs: Pass value, max and milestones ({ at, label }). formatValue turns a number into words ("1,280 points") for the value, the stops and the next-stop line. nextLabel is the template for that line, with {remaining} and {milestone}; the last stop reads Goal reached. Reached stops carry a check, upcoming ones a ring, and the list says so in words. On a narrow container the labels alternate above and below the track.
